purpose: Convert structurally supported BIEN family x trait candidates into semantically valid primary trait systems without choosing traits, units, or aggregation rules after support or effect results are known.
candidate_rule: Only v0.2.2 joint structural support PASS systems enter. No structural failure can be rescued here.

aggregate_only_numeric_check.requirement: Every nonmissing eligible trait_value used by the candidate system must be parseable as a finite numeric value.
aggregate_only_numeric_check.allowed_computation: internally test parseability and finite status; return only counts n_total, n_numeric_valid, n_invalid
aggregate_only_numeric_check.invalid_rule: any invalid value makes that family x trait candidate HOLD; no regex/value-based cleaning may be invented afterward

unit_gate.requirement: Exactly one nonempty BIEN unit label among eligible records for the family x trait candidate.
unit_gate.conversion: No conversion is permitted unless an explicit source-documented conversion was frozen before support results; none is authorized in v0.3.2.

continuous_scalar.temporal_species_state: median of all finite valid values per species
continuous_scalar.support_recheck: After finite-value filtering, at least 20 species must retain a species state.

unit_gate.requirement: Physical unit must be absent. Nonempty unit labels are HOLD unless source documentation established that exact label as unitless before support-result inspection.
unit_gate.note: The authorized list is deliberately empty at freeze time.

nominal_categorical.temporal_species_state: unique modal category across valid measurements
nominal_categorical.tied_mode_rule: Species with a tied modal category are excluded deterministically.
nominal_categorical.aggregate_only_tie_check: Internal category frequencies may be used only to return counts of species with unique versus tied modes; category labels/frequencies are not persisted before outcome opening.
nominal_categorical.support_recheck: At least 20 species must retain a unique modal category.

primary_hold.rule: Always exclude from BIEN primary H1/H2 regardless of structural support.

spatial_recheck.requirement: After the same semantic validity filters, at least 8 species must each retain >=20 geovalid records across >=5 frozen 25-km equal-area cells.

independence_gate.count_rule: A family counts once if at least one semantically valid family x trait system passes all temporal and spatial rechecks.

gate.pass: At least 12 independent families retain one or more semantically valid joint trait systems.
gate.hold: Fewer than 12 families remain; BIEN primary trait route becomes structural/semantic HOLD and may switch only to the already-frozen second trait source AusTraits.
